title: In the same boat.
html_source: Bloom and Mr. Kernan are not practicing Catholics and therefore, in the same boat.

anchor.prefix:
said with reproof. 

 Mr Bloom nodded gravely looking in the quick bloodshot eyes. Secret eyes, secretsearching eyes. Mason, I think: not sure. Beside him again. We are the last.
anchor.suffix:
Hope he'll say something else. 

 Mr Kernan added: 

 — The service of the Irish church used in Mount Jerome is simpler, more impressive I must say. 

 Mr Bloom gave prudent assen
